sections.content: This report summerises daily intrusions and attacks

sections.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', entry_date) as hour, count(*) as
FROM monitoring.alerts_open WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
sections.title: Attack trend
sections.caption: Daily SQL Injections last day

sections.query: select server , root_cause , issue_id ,  substring (query,1,100) query from monitoring.alerts_open where entry_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'

headers.query:
, A.login_name  
from 
(
select at.server ,at.login_name , at.query , last_request_end_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem'last_request_end_time , c.column_name , c.table_name from monitoring.active_transactions at
 join(
select TABLE_NAME ,  column_name from monitoring.schema 

union all  
select  table_name , column_name  from monitoring.sensitive_schema 
) c on at.query like '%'||c.column_name ||'%'
where  last_request_end_time >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '1 day'
and login_name not in ( 'dbdome_mon_usr','ERNNO1\ErnSqlServerAgentUse','NT SERVICE\SQLAgent$ERN','NT SERVICE\SQLTELEMETRY$ERN','ERNNO1\ErnSqlServerUser','NT SERVICE\SQLTELEMETRY')
and login_name like '%\%'
)A
GROUP BY  A.login_name
